lessons_used: Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) has been helpful overall (+4.4% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests while 3 showed no clear effect.
Home redesigns (home, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
Predictions were generally too low for winning tests, underestimating their actual performance.
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that showed no clear effect or performed poorly.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Pre-Adoption Showroom Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new pet showroom screen before friend selection showcasing pet desktop animations and idle behaviors.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 75.2% conversion rate and median 89s; showcasing animated previews upfront builds anticipation and reduces drop-off.

candidates.title: Spotlight Layout Redesign for Pick Friend Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the pick friend screen to a spotlight layout with focused pet view cards and animation preview.
candidates.why: Grid layout redesign was stopped previously, but spotlight layout focuses on one pet at a time, making choice less overwhelming.

guard.reason: Redesigns pick friend screen layout while maintaining its core job of selecting a pet.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns previously showed a negative effect (-8.0%) in tests.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Layout Redesign for Choose Path Screen

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Meet Your Pet?

candidates.title: Two-Column Layout Redesign for Sign-In Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a two-column layout separating account creation and existing user login.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained of missing pets when signing into wrong or duplicate accounts; two-column layout clarifies login options.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Save Your Pet Profile

guard.reason: Redesigns sign-in screen layout while preserving the sign-in functionality.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail evidence (8 emails), though sign-in redesigns historically show flat results.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Redesign for Home Intro Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a stage layout showing the active pet ready on the desktop.
candidates.why: Finish step takes median 395s / mean 5815s; stage layout immediately confirms pet readiness and reduces post-onboarding confusion.

guard.reason: Redesigns home intro screen layout within onboarding boundaries.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 35% of users, but major screen redesigns in late funnel carry high risk.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Quality Guidelines Card
candidates.change: Adds explicit photo clarity and lighting hints to the upload photos screen.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results due to poor input photos.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit, front-facing photos for best custom pet render quality.

guard.reason: Adds helpful quality guidance card to photo upload screen without changing rules or flow.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint addition addressing 3 support emails on photo quality.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Wait Time Estimate and Notification Toggle
candidates.change: Displays live progress timer, time estimate, and a ready notification toggle during pet creation.
candidates.why: Home waiting step averages 2336 seconds; progress feedback and ready notifications prevent users from abandoning during wait.

guard.reason: Adds real progress and notification controls to the waiting screen as allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Directly tackles 2336s mean wait time during pet creation without full home redesign.

candidates.title: Account Cloud Preservation Callout on Sign-In
candidates.change: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly state that signing in binds your pet progress to your account across reinstalls.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after signing in again, indicating confusion about cloud sync.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet in Cloud Storage
sign_in.body: Log in with your primary email to ensure your pet data and progress sync seamlessly across device reinstalls.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.body' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.change: Changes adoption certificate screen to a checklist layout where users review care commitments before finalizing.
candidates.why: 3 support emails asked how to control or hide pets after onboarding; checklist format sets expectations before completion.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your adoption terms and review daily care commitments.

guard.reason: Redesigns adoption certificate layout while retaining its function as the official certificate.

candidates.score_note: Resolves user confusion reported in support emails, but checklist layout adds user friction.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in steps (sign_in, reorder) proved helpful (+4.4% average after noise correction), winning 3 tests while 3 showed no clear effect.
Home redesigns (home, redesign) showed no clear effect across 2 tests (-3.3% average after noise correction).
Adoption new flows (adoption, new_flow) were helpful (+4.2% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Choose path redesigns (choose_path, redesign) were helpful (+2.9% average after noise correction), winning 1 test while 1 showed no clear effect.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, finish new_screen, and sign_in redesign, as only 1 test has been completed for each.
